title: Document Bahtinov mask focusing in the Imager Agent
description: Create indigo_drivers/agent_imager/doc/BAHTINOV.md in English using the established technical reference format and header. Explain the optical origin of the three diffraction spikes and the focus criterion. Trace the actual indigo_libs/indigo_bahtinov.c analysis pipeline from supported pixels to measured spike lines, outer-line intersection and signed pixel error, including known/free mask angles, confidence and rejection. Explain what the Imager Agent learns, displays and uses to drive iterative autofocus. Document concrete implementation and practical optical limitations, supported frames, failure behavior and interpretation of the sign/units. Link source and existing tests, distinguishing tested behavior from practical guidance. Verify against the current implementation and documentation links. Documentation only.
